logs.name: registry
logs.text: Browser shard coverage: 514 cases in 176 intact files; 129/129/129/127 cases across all four shards.

implementation: Only four browser fixture/helper files change. The original real-service case observes one same-origin Board star mutation start for owner, distinct account and original recovery; both PUT/DELETE count, so a wrong or failed request cannot cause another activation. Original owner2/other1 count, same-key/version/history/timezone/private live/worker/focus and original5s/120s checks remain. Nonmutating Done observes one native click; original focus-return assertion remains.
nativeBehavior: A real routed control retains an original uncertain PUT, reads a later authoritative unstarred version2, waits through focus-triggered private read admission with zero extra writes, emits one held recovery request, keeps it unconfirmed after a failed reply without replay, then accepts only a new explicit same-key/version0 recovery activation. Four widths,200% text,Axe,denied withdrawal and zero unrelated domain writes pass in both presentations.
limitations: Controlled native proof does not qualify distinct-account/actual Worker delivery or original private history. Current remote551 remains Failed. Remaining current matrix results and a complete fresh new-head qualification, strict performance, release, review and verified main integration are required. No application/API/schema/tenant/actor/command-recovery/dependency/testbudget/CI behavior changed.
